title: Improving our LinkedIn profile to start getting found for jobs 🔎
description:
When recruiters are viewing your profile, they’re using keywords to find candidates. These can be job titles, tenure, location, even hard skills The goal is to make your profile show up when a recruiter is searching for keyword terms. Fill your profile out and make sure you’re listing all hard skills and relevant information in your job experience. Final step, use the Teal LinkedIn Review Tool to double check you are good to go, and upload your resume to your LinkedIn since that now counts as searchable content. #linkedin #linkedintips #linkedinprofile #linkedinprofiletips
